CharacterDialogue.Text: (Finally, my first day at the Digital Media Lab. They say only the bravest of all can participate in an experiment like this...)
(I hope I am prepared enough. This is so exciting!)
Ah, there you are! Took you long enough!
Well, the Deutsche Bahn kind of doesn't expect snow in winter, so the trains were late by merely... 120 minutes.
We have no time for any chit-chat. They have received the order. Now, we need to act and we act fast.
Okay, what is it that I should do? You were so secretive in the flyer.
A special assignment, a special case. We successfully infiltrated a robot at this restaurant "The Orange Kitten".
Ohhh, I've heard about it. They make very delicious food! One time, I ate so much, I actually vom-
Regardless, you are here today to work with the robot we've infiltrated there. We need to know the secret behind the tasty recipes.
